name: 估值透视
description_zh: 五步估值导航：先判断公司类型（成长/价值/周期/金融）→ 匹配最优估值方法 → 拆解股价隐含预期 → 历史中枢与行业均值对比 → 识别重估与杀估值的触发因素。回答"该用什么方法估、现在贵不贵、未来有没有重估空间"。
description_en: A five-step valuation guide — first determine company type (growth / value / cyclical / financial) then match the optimal valuation method, decompose price-implied expectations, compare against historical center and industry average, and identify re-rating and de-rating triggers. Answers three key questions: which valuation method to use, whether the current price is expensive, and whether re-rating upside exists.
